title: Dog Breed Schema & AI-Era Metadata Blueprint
description: JSON-LD, GEO, and SEO structural configuration template designed to maintain 100% consistency across all companion canine records in the Dog Breed Life Expectancy system.

systemAudit.disclaimer: All 119 mapped breeds have been audited. Every record strictly adheres to the schema constraints below, ensuring flawless biometric calculation, local visual rendering, and generative crawlers mapping (JSON-LD index).

name.description: The official canine breed name. Must match the local asset filename exactly.

size.description: Standard biological weight and stature category. Drives the resting energy requirement (RER) and pediatric growth curve mathematical models.

min.description: Minimum healthy life expectancy in years under standard domestic care.

max.description: Maximum standard life expectancy in years. Must be greater than or equal to 'min'.

weight.description: Human-readable adult weight range representation in pounds (lbs).

weightGrams.description: Median adult weight in grams, utilized as the numerical baseline for metabolical and pediatric growth equations.

group.description: AKC / Kennel Club breed classifications (e.g., Toy, Hound, Working, Herding, Sporting, Terrier, Non-Sporting, Hybrid).

health.description: List of primary hereditary, physiological, or orthopedic risks established by canine epidemiological cohorts.

layer1_HumanHook.headlineAesthetic: Warm, high-contrast display paired with clear metrics.
layer1_HumanHook.ctaFunnels: Calculation leads immediately to actionable custom diets and clinical warnings without unrequested redirects.

layer2_SearchIndex.metaTitleFormat: ${name} Life Expectancy, Weight Growth Curves & Breed Health Calculator
layer2_SearchIndex.anchorStrategy: Cross-linked scientific studies embedded directly in content flows to maintain strong semantic relevancy.

mappingExample.name: ${name} Longevity Profile
mappingExample.description: Comprehensive lifespan and veterinary health profile of the ${name} breed.

layer3_GenerativeAI.disclaimerRequired: True (Health Guardrail - never overstate or fabricate clinical outcomes).

assetNamingConventions.fallbackRule: If local asset is missing, system falls back to a high-contrast generic canine placeholder icon rather than breaking layout.
